source_text: All nine sequenced mosquitoes from malaria-endemic areas at highland areas around the Kisumu district in western Kenya are homozygous for the insecticide resistant allele cytosine, which forms the code of “TCA” and encodes amino acid serine in the voltage-gated sodium channel [19]. ... Indeed, all mosquitoes that we sequenced (n = 9) harbored the resistance allele (1014S) instead of the wild type allele (1014L).

The well-known kdr mutations, which change codon 1014 from leucine to serine or phenylalanine within the para gene coding region, confer insecticide resistance [25–27]. Indeed, all mosquitoes that we sequenced (n = 9) harbored the resistance allele (1014S) instead of the wild type allele (1014L).
